## tal-a14-p01–p05 — ahnika 14
**SUMMARY.** [and]-:C14 atha śrītantrāloke caturdaśamāhnikam tirobhāvasvarūpaṃ tu kathyamānaṃ vivicyatām / svabhāvāt parameśāno niyatyaniyatikramam spṛśanprakāśate yena tataḥ svacchanda ucyate / niyatiṃ karmaphalayorāśrityaiṣa maheśvaraḥ sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānvidhatte@vāntarasthitīn / mahāsarge punaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārānantyaśālini ekaḥ sa devo viśvātmā niyatityāgataḥ prabhuḥ / avāntare yā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiścātrāpyayantritam nojjhatyeṣa vapustyaktaniyatiśca sthito@tra tat / niyatyaiva yadā caiṣa svarūpācchādanakramāt bhuṅkte duḥkhavimohādi tadā karmaphalakramaḥ / tyaktvā tu niyamaṃ kārmaṃ duḥkhamohaparītatām bibhāsayiṣurāste@yaṃ tirodhāne@napekṣakaḥ / yathā prakāśasvātantryāt pratibuddho@pyabuddhavat āste tadvadanuttīrṇo@pyuttīrṇa iva ceṣṭate / yathā ca buddhastāṃ mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ kurvannapi dviṣan hṛdyāste mūḍha evaṃ hi prabuddhānāṃ viceṣṭitam / śrīvidyādhipatiścāha mānastotre tadīdṛśam ye yauṣmāke śāsanamārge kṛtadīkṣāḥ saṃgacchanto mohavaśādvipratipattim / nūnaṃ teṣā nāsti bhavadbhānuniyogaḥ saṅkocaḥ kiṃ sūryakaraistāmarasānām [and]-jñātajñeyā dhātṛpadasthā api santo ye tvanmārgātkāpathagāste@pi na samyaka / prāyasteṣāṃ laiṅgikabuddhyādisamuttho mithyābodhaḥ sarpavasādīpajakalpaḥ yasmādviddhaṃ sūtakamukhyena nu tāmraṃ tadyadbhūyaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ no samupeyāt / no taiḥ pītaṃ bhūtalasaṃsthairamṛtaṃ tadyeṣāṃ tṛṭkṣudduḥkhavibādhāḥ punarasmin tataḥ prabuddhaceṣṭāsau mantracaryārcanādikā / dveṣeddhāntardahatyenaṃ dāhaḥ śaṅkaiva sā yataḥ na cāsya karmamahimā tādṛgyenetthamāsta saḥ / kiṃ hi tatkarma kasmādvā pūrveṇātra samo vidhiḥ tasmātsā parameśecchā yayāyaṃ mohitastathā / anantakālasaṃvedyaduḥkhapātratvamīhate tatrāpi cecchāvaicitryādihāmutrobhayātmakaḥ / duḥkhasyāpi vibhedo@sti ciraśaighryakṛtastathā kālakāmāndhakādīnāṃ paulastyapuravāsinām / tathānyeṣāṃ tirobhāvastāvadduḥkho hyamutra ca anyo@pi ca tirobhāvaḥ samayollaṅghanātmakaḥ / yaduktaṃ parameśena śrīmadānandagahvare samayollaṅghanāddevi kravyādatvaṃ śataṃ samāḥ / tatrāpi mandatīvrādibhedādbahuvidhaḥ kramaḥ svātantryācca maheśasya tirobhūto@pyasau svayam / paradvāreṇa vābhyeti bhūyo@nugrahamapyalam [and]-bhūyo@nugrahataḥ prāyaścittādyācaraṇe sati / anusāreṇa dīkṣādau kṛte syācchivatāmayaḥ tirobhūtaḥ paretāsurapi bandhusuhṛdgurūn / ālambya śaktipātena dīkṣādyairanugṛhyate tatrāpi kālaśīghratvaciratvādivibhedatām / tathaiti śaktipāto@sau yenāyāti śivātmatām itthaṃ sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsatirobhāvamanugrahaḥ / iti pañcasu kartṛtvaṃ śivatvaṃ saṃvidātmanaḥ pañcakṛtyasvatantratvasaṃpūrṇasvātmamāninaḥ / yogino@rcājapadhyānayogāḥ saṃsyuḥ sadoditāḥ aindrajālikavṛttānte na rajyeta kadācana / sādāśivo@pi yo bhogo bandhaḥ so@pyucitātmanām jñātṛtvameva śivatā svātantryaṃ tadihocyate / kulālavattu kartṛtvaṃ na mukhyaṃ tadadhiṣṭhiteḥ iti jñātvā grahītavyā naiva jātvapi khaṇḍanā / śivo@haṃ cenmadicchānuvarti kiṃ na jagattviti mamecchāmanuvartantāmityatrāhaṃvidi sphuret / śivo vā parameśāno dehādiratha nirmitaḥ śivasya tāvadastyetaddehastveṣa tathā tvayā / kṛtaḥ kānyā dehatāsya tatkiṃ syādvācyatāpadam [and]-uktaṃ ca siddhasantānaśrīmadūrmimahākule / pavanabhramaṇaprāṇavikṣepādikṛtaśramāḥ kuhakādiṣu ye bhrāntāste bhrāntāḥ parame pade / sarvatra bahumānena yāpyutkrāntirvimuktaye proktā sā sāraśāstreṣu bhogopāyatayoditā / yadi sarvagatā devo vadotkramya kva yāsyati athāsarvagatastarhi ghaṭatulyastadā bhavet / utkrāntividhiyogo@yamekadeśena kathyate niraṃśe śivatattve tu kathamutkrāntisaṃgatiḥ / yathā dharādau vāyvante bhṛgvambvagnyupavāsakaiḥ ātmano yojanaṃ vyomni tadvadutkrāntivartanā / tasmānnotkramayejjīvaṃ paratattvasamīhayā śrīpūrvaśāstre tūktaṃ yadutkrānterlakṣaṇaṃ na tat / muktyupāyatayā kiṃtu bhogahānyai tathaiṣaṇāt japadhyānādisaṃsiddhaḥ svātantryācchaktipātataḥ / bhogaṃ prati viraktaśceditthaṃ dehaṃ tyajediti svacchandamṛtyorapi yad bhīṣmādeḥ śrūyate kila / bhogavairasyasaṃprāptau jīvitāntopasarpaṇam yogamantrāmṛtadravyavarādyaiḥ siddhibhāktanuḥ / hātuṃ nahyanyathā śakyā vinoktakramayogataḥ [and]-uktaṃ ca mālinītantre parameśena tādṛśam / sarvamapyathavā bhogaṃ manyamāno virūpakam ityādi vadatā sarvairalakṣyāntaḥsatattvakam / evaṃ sṛṣṭyādikartavyasvasvātantryopadeśanam yatsaiva mukhyadīkṣā syācchiṣyasya śivadāyinī / uktaṃ śrīniśicāre ca bhairavīyeṇa tejasā vyāptaṃ viśvaṃ prapaśyanti vikalpojjhitacetasaḥ / vikalpayuktacittastu piṇḍapātācchivaṃ vrajet bāhyadīkṣādiyogena caryāsamayakalpanaiḥ / avikalpastathādyaiva jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ saṃsārajīrṇatarumūlakalāpakalpasaṃkalpasāntaratayā paramārthavahneḥ / syurvisphuliṅgakaṇikā api cettadante dedīpyate vimalabodhahutāśarāśiḥ itthaṃ dīkṣopakramo@yaṃ darśitaḥ śāstrasaṃmataḥ / [AbhT_14.47]

source.text: [and]-bhūyo@nugrahataḥ prāyaścittādyācaraṇe sati / anusāreṇa dīkṣādau kṛte syācchivatāmayaḥ tirobhūtaḥ paretāsurapi bandhusuhṛdgurūn / ālambya śaktipātena dīkṣādyairanugṛhyate tatrāpi kālaśīghratvaciratvādivibhedatām / tathaiti śaktipāto@sau yenāyāti śivātmatām itthaṃ sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsatirobhāvamanugrahaḥ / iti pañcasu kartṛtvaṃ śivatvaṃ saṃvidātmanaḥ pañcakṛtyasvatantratvasaṃpūrṇasvātmamāninaḥ / yogino@rcājapadhyānayogāḥ saṃsyuḥ sadoditāḥ aindrajālikavṛttānte na rajyeta kadācana / sādāśivo@pi yo bhogo bandhaḥ so@pyucitātmanām jñātṛtvameva śivatā svātantryaṃ tadihocyate / kulālavattu kartṛtvaṃ na mukhyaṃ tadadhiṣṭhiteḥ iti jñātvā grahītavyā naiva jātvapi khaṇḍanā / śivo@haṃ cenmadicchānuvarti kiṃ na jagattviti mamecchāmanuvartantāmityatrāhaṃvidi sphuret / śivo vā parameśāno dehādiratha nirmitaḥ śivasya tāvadastyetaddehastveṣa tathā tvayā / kṛtaḥ kānyā dehatāsya tatkiṃ syādvācyatāpadam

source.text: [and]-uktaṃ ca siddhasantānaśrīmadūrmimahākule / pavanabhramaṇaprāṇavikṣepādikṛtaśramāḥ kuhakādiṣu ye bhrāntāste bhrāntāḥ parame pade / sarvatra bahumānena yāpyutkrāntirvimuktaye proktā sā sāraśāstreṣu bhogopāyatayoditā / yadi sarvagatā devo vadotkramya kva yāsyati athāsarvagatastarhi ghaṭatulyastadā bhavet / utkrāntividhiyogo@yamekadeśena kathyate niraṃśe śivatattve tu kathamutkrāntisaṃgatiḥ / yathā dharādau vāyvante bhṛgvambvagnyupavāsakaiḥ ātmano yojanaṃ vyomni tadvadutkrāntivartanā / tasmānnotkramayejjīvaṃ paratattvasamīhayā śrīpūrvaśāstre tūktaṃ yadutkrānterlakṣaṇaṃ na tat / muktyupāyatayā kiṃtu bhogahānyai tathaiṣaṇāt japadhyānādisaṃsiddhaḥ svātantryācchaktipātataḥ / bhogaṃ prati viraktaśceditthaṃ dehaṃ tyajediti svacchandamṛtyorapi yad bhīṣmādeḥ śrūyate kila / bhogavairasyasaṃprāptau jīvitāntopasarpaṇam yogamantrāmṛtadravyavarādyaiḥ siddhibhāktanuḥ / hātuṃ nahyanyathā śakyā vinoktakramayogataḥ

source.text: [and]-uktaṃ ca mālinītantre parameśena tādṛśam / sarvamapyathavā bhogaṃ manyamāno virūpakam ityādi vadatā sarvairalakṣyāntaḥsatattvakam / evaṃ sṛṣṭyādikartavyasvasvātantryopadeśanam yatsaiva mukhyadīkṣā syācchiṣyasya śivadāyinī / uktaṃ śrīniśicāre ca bhairavīyeṇa tejasā vyāptaṃ viśvaṃ prapaśyanti vikalpojjhitacetasaḥ / vikalpayuktacittastu piṇḍapātācchivaṃ vrajet bāhyadīkṣādiyogena caryāsamayakalpanaiḥ / avikalpastathādyaiva jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ saṃsārajīrṇatarumūlakalāpakalpasaṃkalpasāntaratayā paramārthavahneḥ / syurvisphuliṅgakaṇikā api cettadante dedīpyate vimalabodhahutāśarāśiḥ itthaṃ dīkṣopakramo@yaṃ darśitaḥ śāstrasaṃmataḥ / [AbhT_14.47]
